Note: Ideal production state. The current demo deployment does NOT use Private Endpoints, VNet integration, App Gateway, Firewall, Bastion, or Key Vault. All services authenticate via Managed Identity (no secrets). Playwright test workspace omitted. Icons rendered in official Azure iconography style (self-contained inline SVG).
